# Kition Vector Support

## Questions about using Kition Vector

Start with the [README](../README.md) and the docs at [Kition for Developers](https://developer.kition.ai).

## Bug Reports

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-vector/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
for a reproducible problem in the editor, the engine, or the headless executable. Search
existing issues first and include the kit version or commit, the file format, a minimal
sample file, and where it runs.

## Requests

Use the [request form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-vector/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
for a missing feature, a file format, an agent command, or a mistake in the documentation.

## Security Reports

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Follow the
[security policy](SECURITY.md).

## Contribution Help

Questions about local setup, checks, or pull requests start with
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
